svg.title: Blockchain-Inspired Voting System: hash chain detail, services and notes
svg.text: An online election platform where tampering with stored votes is detectable. Six Spring Boot services.
h(n) = SHA-256( userId + candidateId + electionId + epochSeconds + h(n−1) )
If any field of vote 3 is edited, its hash becomes h₃′. Vote 4 still stores h₃, so POST /api/v1/votes/chain/validate/{electionId} reports the broken
Concurrent votes lock the election's chain head (SELECT … FOR UPDATE), so they link one after another.
A Redis key rejects a double vote fast. A unique database constraint is the final guard.
Resilience4j circuit breakers, Prometheus and Grafana, Zipkin tracing, ELK logs, Docker Compose and
Java 17, Spring Boot 3.3, Spring Cloud 2023, Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL.
